Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Rigidize Clothing
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Push Stormlight into the fibers of your clothing and feel them stiffen beneath your fingers. Linen becomes hard as steel. A simple shirt turns rigid enough to stop a blade. The fabric does not change its appearance, but something about the way it moves tells you it is no longer just cloth.
